TEXT: Today's the date.

When it comes to dating, I haven't the slightest idea 
of what's okay and what's not... even stuff like 
clothing... Wonder if my outfit's okay?

I got worked up and I thought I would come in 
new clothes, but...

But if she went, "Senpai, you really put some work 
into this *snicker*", that would be embarrassing.

Looks like Sena had her usual getup on as well... 
Thank goodness there wasn't anything strange.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[font_size=18]*sigh*... I'm glad I didn't put too much effort into my clothes... 
right...?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm? Did you say something?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Ah, no I was just talking to myself! More 
importantly, wasn't the roller coaster fun!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: My eyes are spinning... Here, this is yours.

Sitting on the bench and having a break, I handed 
her some ice cream. Sena snatched it instantly and 
took a bite.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Yay, Senpai's treat! Thanks for the food!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey now, you're not a kid so don't just devour it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Having you treat me to ice cream brought up 
some fond memories-

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
When I stayed in the club room working on the 
project, and you gave me some stuff.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah... That was a lot of work, but it sure was fun.

Between the two of us, we had a sense of 
camaraderie when working on the game, along 
with being a pair of upper and lower-classmen.

Stuff like a guy and a girl dating and the acts that come 
with it... In reality, there's no need to be mindful of such 
things. We've always had fun together anyway.

Besides, Sena's been acting a bit childish today, far 
from what a lover should be... almost like she's a 
cute little sister.

Ignoring our surroundings and acting like a spoiled 
kid, she seems more relaxed around me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Senpai, you have some cream on your lips.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, you're right.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Geez... If you have white stuff on that particular 
spot, the fujoshi around here might get excited, 
you know...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=28]Th-They're actually around here as well!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Well I'm here, so we can't say there's no one fitting 
that description. Going by that logic, "If you find 
one, there may be 30 others."

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Since you put it that way, I guess...

...It's great that the conversation keeps going, but 
before I knew it we were talking about BL, what's 
the deal with that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: By the way, Sena...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Somehow, I've been getting the feeling that we're 
being watched... What about you?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Huh? It doesn't really seem that way to me 
though...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [font_size=10]My Sena-chan... My Sena-chan... My Sena-chan...[/font_size]

From the moment since we arrived at the park, 
there was that strange feeling of being watched...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Well, whatever. It's probably my imagination.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Don't tell me that you were so engaged in 
debugging the game daily, you've started trying to 
find bugs in real life?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Haha... That might be true. I've got to take a break 
and relax today.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Right!! So, should we ride that one next?

Sena pulled my hand, beaming with enjoyment. Her 
innocent face is so cute that it's irresistible.

Oh yeah, near the end of summer vacation... there was 
that incident of someone's chest thrust upon my face... 
Maybe we'll continue from where we left off?

The breast countdown has been going fine and all... 
Shouldn't an event be coming soon? Right?

I can't stand it. I wanna start from the first scene, 
turn on "skip read text", and do it over.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Hey Senpai, I have a funny story to tell you.

While we had our rest, Sena preached with a bitter 
smile on.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
About Onii-chan, it seems like he concluded that I 
was dating Makabe-senpai? So that's why he joined 
the Game Research club that day!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah, he was quite blatant with that... I didn't think 
he would actually stay though.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You knew about this? About Onii-chan's 
misunderstanding, I mean.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, w-well yeah.

I better not bring up the fact that he asked me for 
some advice over that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Still, it's unfortunate for Makabe-kun to experience 
that harassment without a shred of evidence...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Actually, there's a reason why he was suspicious of 
him.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=28]Huh, what reason?![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You remember that drama CD with the voice actor 
that sounded like Makabe-senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, when we went to Akiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Apparently, he overheard me listening to that in my 
room and thought, "Sena-chan is getting along with 
a boy!"

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wow... What a case of mistaken identity.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Well I did listen to that CD a lot, and he heard me 
talking to Makabe-senpai on the phone which led to 
him concluding, "It's the same voice!"

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I had pictures of him as a reference for the 
protagonist, so that's what started the 
misunderstanding.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
What is he even thinking... Chasing his little sister and 
threatening Makabe over a misunderstanding...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
And after all that, he didn't even realize that I liked 
Senpai. He really is an idiot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah... He sure is.
Th-That's me, right?
Huh...? Since when did Sena... like me...

Wait hold it. I have to find the right time to confirm 
this for myself. That has to be the date's conclusion.

Our fun time together passed in the blink of an eye... 
I decide to end the day with the ride on the Ferris 
Wheel.

A gondola that slowly spins as you watch the 
scenery, having an intimate talk... For a date's 
conclusion, it has to be the highlight.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
The line sure is long around this time of day. Not 
only that, it's all couples.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ah, we made it! Let's ride it, Senpai!
The moment we got on the Ferris Wheel's cab--

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Kyaa!!
A dark figure pulled Sena out of the cab!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=28]Hey, what are you doing?![/font_size]

I immediately tried to pursue Sena, but a strange 
figure blocked the entrance and I couldn't get off. 
Not only that, that "thing" forced its way in.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...A mascot...

Isn't that the mascot that was handing out balloons 
to children earlier?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh!
The door closed and the Ferris Wheel started rising.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: U-Um, is this part of the attraction?

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: ...Shut up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT:
...One, taking someone's sister... two, insolent behavior... 
three, you appeared before me, you bastard...

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN
TEXT: [font_size=33]Akagi Kouhei, has arrived.[/font_size]
